falsifier_requirement.trigger: Heldout trip counts leak into formula selection, fewer than 20 route-hour rows are scored, source hashes drift, or the seasonal comparator ties or beats the model within uncertainty.

formula_requirement.formula_or_model: Fit a training-only graph-temporal autoregressive count model using prior route counts, hour/day effects, pickup/dropoff zone adjacency, and weather/calendar flags if locked before scoring.

incumbent_comparator_requirement.baseline_name: seasonal carry-forward and route-hour mean comparator
incumbent_comparator_requirement.prediction_rule: predict each heldout route-hour count from last visible count and training-only route/hour mean
incumbent_comparator_requirement.required_material_margin: model residual must beat comparator residual under the declared domain-local metric

next_escalation: If status is CAPABILITY_DEVELOPMENT_REQUIRED, implement the listed script/flags/model support. If evidence remains negative, preserve fail-closed science and repair the model/comparator rather than flipping PASS.
no_fake_closure_policy: This execution cannot close broad superiority unless the downstream scoring and replay artifacts pass.
pass_predicate: A governed domain scorer script/flags exist, run cleanly, and the downstream domain-scoring report plus oc_prediction_scoring_row become PASS.
repair_strategy: Implement or repair the exact domain scorer until the downstream scoring artifact passes or remains honestly fail-closed with a narrower research blocker.

required_source_block.source_authority: New York City Taxi and Limousine Commission
required_source_block.source_name: New York City Taxi and Limousine Commission Trip Record Data

residual_requirement.formula: absolute count residual and Poisson deviance per route-hour

target_variable.extraction_rule: Trip records are aggregated into a zone-hour flow panel; heldout hours and route counts remain sealed until graph-temporal predictions are written.
target_variable.name: heldout_zone_hour_trip_flow_count
target_variable.unit: trip records per pickup zone, dropoff zone, and hour

uncertainty_requirement.metric: absolute count residual and Poisson deviance per route-hour
uncertainty_requirement.rule: rolling training residual envelope with count-scale Poisson interval

why_it_failed: The domain scorer ran, but the OC model/comparator/materiality predicates remain fail-closed.
